headline: Thunderstorms are holding flights into Newark.

items.text: The FAA has a ground stop for flights into Newark until 8:30 PM ET because of thunderstorms, and those flights are held at their departure airport. The FAA rates the chance of an extension as high.

Newark is lowest of the seven hubs reporting, with 58% of departures so far today within 30 minutes of schedule. Low visibility, thunderstorms and wind gusting to 34 knots are slowing arrivals and departures, and 11 confirmed cancellations are among its 385 departures.
The other hubs are running normally.
A ground delay program is also slowing flights into LaGuardia until 11:59 PM ET because of thunderstorms, with delays averaging 54 minutes and up to 121 minutes.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport; if you are flying to LaGuardia, expect delays until 11:59 PM ET.
